mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'INCOME' THEN amount END), 0) AS "income", COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'EXPENSE' THEN amount END), 0) AS "expense" FROM ledger_entry WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND entry_date BETWEEN #{from} AND #{to}
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) FROM asset WHERE user_id = #{userId}
SELECT id, amount, day_of_month AS "dayOfMonth", adjust FROM recurring_item WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND active AND type = 'EXPENSE'
